task: Three-stage mobile rental checkout using the user's design references

implementation.flow: Dates → Contact → Review; shared desktop state with a two-column desktop layout
implementation.billing: Only explicit useDates are billed. 17 October is one shop-local calendar day, 12:00 AM–11:59 PM. Pickup/return transit dates do not automatically become paid dates. Full custody/preparation/cleaning availability remains authoritative.
implementation.dates: Actual API shop slots, holidays, timezone and configured policy. Invalid saved 11 PM selections require correction. Duplicate, impossible, out-of-period and outside-hours dates are rejected.
implementation.contact: Verified-account shortcut; inline send/verify/resend OTP, backend digit count/cooldown/expiry metadata, paste/autofill, changed-number invalidation. Only a backend-verified phone account can reserve.
implementation.state: Same-store session drafts retain dates, selected items, quantities and contact/address fields; guest contacts and phone entry expire after 30 minutes. OTP digits stay in memory. Account-provider remount uses a five-minute code-free handoff, followed by a fresh quote. Sensitive fields never enter the URL.
implementation.review: Actual product photos, title, size/colour, quantity, date timeline, fulfilment and verified contact with edit controls. Itemized rent, services, delivery/collection, refundable security, included tax, total, due-now and pickup balance. Policy consent is unchecked and invalidated after changes.
implementation.payment: Policy-controlled ADVANCE, FULL and PICKUP plans use existing server pricing, atomic idempotent holds, gateway verification and signed callback recovery. Unknown reservation outcomes retry the exact accepted attempt.
implementation.operations: Existing booking confirmation, tracking, invoices, admin cancellation review/refund policy, inspection and settlement retained. No fake physical inventory or photo-derived prices added.
implementation.ui: Warm neutral background, burgundy actions, compact white cards, three-stage progress, responsive item cards, available time pills, fixed mobile total/action, safe-area and visualViewport keyboard handling. Help/privacy controls remain unobstructed.

coverage: Inline OTP success, failure, length, resend cooldown, expiry, paste, middle-digit deletion and refresh
Changed number cannot reuse old verification, including after refresh
Verified-account skip and contact handoff across account remount
Sanitized account/store draft isolation and expiration
Delivery address required only for delivery and fresh quote after edits
Fresh quote and unchecked policy after Review refresh
Changed price/policy rejects reservation without bag consumption
Unknown hold result recovers the exact request after refresh
Rental bag, My rentals and existing payment recovery
17 October counts once across free pickup/return dates; quantity and security arithmetic
Separated calendar use days, duplicates, strict dates and shop slots
Atomic last-piece concurrency and custody/cleaning buffers
Server quote fingerprint and payment-plan acceptance
Ownership, store restrictions, transaction and staff boundaries
Hold expiry, late payments, signed payment verification and duplicate recovery
Pickup confirmation without fake collection; full payment before handover
Cancellation, itemized assessment, deposit refund and inventory release

browser.engine: Headless Chrome; local real Express API and isolated MongoDB replica set
flows: Catalogue → exact offer → rental bag → Dates → inline OTP Contact → fresh Review → pickup booking → invoice → customer cancellation request → staff approval
FULL payment with two real fixture offers and a long title; invalid signature rejected while HELD, correct signature confirms, duplicate verification records one collection
ADVANCE payment with server due-now amount, captured confirmation and preserved pickup balance
browser.refreshAndBack: Name, dates, challenge metadata and rental bag restored; no OTP persisted; edit paths require review again
browser.keyboard: 390px resized visual viewport keeps focused OTP input above the fixed action footer; actual iPhone keyboard/Safari unverified

verification.countNote: These are final applicable scoped runs, not a full-project total. Repeated and historical overlapping runs are not summed.
